dimensions.note: OAuth2 client credentials: clientSecret is sensitive-marked, sent only in the AAD token POST body, the bearer token lives in memory for one call, and nothing is put on a command line (no az CLI). The shared _lib/arm.ts unwraps ARM {error:{code,message}} and AAD {error,error_description}, redacting the secret and token before truncation and redacting the code (tested). Known external issue swamp-club lab 3555: the CLI prints literal sensitive arguments, so README examples pass clientSecret as a vault reference only and never show --json.
Each method logs once with structured placeholders (VM name, state); no credential, token or request body in log fields.

ARM and AAD failures become a typed ArmError with a redacted code and message; get on a missing VM fails typed and sync records not_found; long operations poll with a bounded timeout and fail with a typed timeout.

26 unit/contract tests with an injected fetch, clock and sleep (no socket): adopt-without-PUT, create and poll, delete and delete-again no-op, deallocate, start no-op when running, strict schemas, injection in every name, no password in the body, error unwrap and redaction. Live end-to-end is BLOCKED (needs an Azure subscription and a service principal scoped to a throwaway resource group); every live cell is recorded as blocked in LOGBOOK, which is why the channel is beta.

create adopts an existing VM and never issues a PUT; delete on an absent VM is a clean no-op; start is a no-op when already running; every mutation polls to the target provisioning or power state before recording. Residual MEDIUM: deallocate and stop always POST even when already in the target state (Azure accepts the repeat; not yet verified live).
Azure Resource Manager REST, Microsoft.Compute API version 2024-07-01 pinned in every URL; deallocate is a real deallocate with optional hibernate, distinct from stop (power off, still billed).
No local process, file or socket is held past a call; polling is bounded by timeoutMs (max 1 h) and pollIntervalMs.

Manifest @randybias/azure-vm, two-sentence description, Apache-2.0, additionalFiles README.md and LICENSE.txt. deallocate, stop and delete are DESTRUCTIVE.; get and sync are READ-ONLY. Fixtures use synthetic GUIDs and example names; leak scan, gitleaks and fixture guard pass. Residual MEDIUM: README shows the state key as <subscription>-<resource-group>-<name> but the instance name is length-prefixed; fix in the next version.

Global arguments are an empty strictObject; every method argument object is strict; subscription is a GUID, names, resource group, location, size and image fields carry grammars and length bounds; admin access is an SSH public key only with password authentication disabled. Residual MEDIUM: tags is not bounded to Azure's tag-count limit.
create (or adopt), get, sync, start, deallocate, stop and delete. All mutators are kind action, so no lifecycle verb tombstones the definition.
All names and the request body are validated before the token request; create GETs first and adopts rather than overwriting.
Length-prefixed components of subscription, resource group and VM name (resourceInstanceName), so distinct targets cannot collide.
Every target and credential arrives as method arguments, so one generic definition serves any subscription; the model reads no other model's data.
First release (2026.10.17.1): no earlier version or stored data to upgrade.
